lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Basin, 2031. Four hundred hectares of graded sand, a frame going up in the middle of it, and a pour schedule that does not stop for dark.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Meridian's filings say this is a logistics facility. Logistics facilities do not need four hundred megawatts.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: It's a hole in the ground with money going into it. Everything I hate started as one of these.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Eight hundred people are building it and not one of them has been told what it is. That is the part worth writing down.
